title.narrative: Welthungerhilfe Anticipatory Humanitarian Action Facility (WAHAFA) Ethiopia Build Project

description.narrative: Develop Anticipatory Action Practices for drought and flood hazards considered in the pastoral and agropastoral based on harmonized triggers and thresholds using traditional and conventional knowledge in Oromia Region.

This goal of this project, in alignment with the Welthungerhilfe Anticipatory Humanitarian Action Facility (WAHAFA), aims to reduce the impact of drought and floods in Borena zone (Oromia region), by implementing early, pre-determined interventions based on early warning data. Through anticipatory action, the project seeks to minimize loss of life and protect livelihoods among vulnerable pastoralist communities. Within this build project, the participating organizations will develop localized and community based Anticipatory Action Protocols. Therefore, a holistic risk and participatory impact assessment will be conducted to identify expected impacts and coping strategies of participating communities.

This project aims to improve the well-being of 82,985 at-risk individuals, with a particular emphasis on the most vulnerable: women, children, the elderly, and people with disabilities. The beneficiaries include pastoralist communities facing drought, agro-pastoralist communities susceptible to flooding, and residents of nearby towns identified during community level risk assessments. The targeting strategy will be developed at the start of the project and regularly updated through community engagement.
